description: Source code for task management API in the Superset project, defining task statuses, scope, properties, context, and decorators for task scheduling and execution.

classes.name: TaskContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for task context, providing methods to update task state, register cleanup and abort handlers.

classes.name: TaskWrapper
classes.description: Generic class representing the task decorator's wrapper, providing call and schedule methods.

classes.name: TaskOptions
classes.description: Immutable dataclass for specifying task execution options like task key, name, and timeout.

classes.name: TaskProperties
classes.description: TypedDict for task runtime state and configuration, stored as JSON.

classes.name: TaskStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible task execution statuses.

classes.name: TaskScope
classes.description: Enumeration of task visibility and access scope.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Abstract method to atomically update task progress and payload.

methods.name: on_cleanup
methods.description: Register a cleanup handler to run when the task ends.

methods.name: on_abort
methods.description: Register a handler to run when the task is aborted.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Decorator to register a task with optional name, scope, and timeout.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Method to schedule the task for asynchronous execution.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Retrieve the current task context from ambient context.
